Here's something you can try:

I read a book a long time ago about communication patterns. Just hear this out. What happens is people get stuck into repeating the same pattern, one statement triggers the next response and so on. That just leads onward to a fight, when you get stuck in a bad pattern, and it repeats over and over again getting worse over time. This eventually leads to divorce, or worse. What is really happening is you are really having the same fight, over and over again.

So the trick here is to break out of the pattern. First you have to see the pattern, both with her and you, because you are both doing it - a lot of it is subconscious - the pattern is already ingrained so your brain just races through it. This requires you to pay very close attention to the pattern of the conversation, so you can identify the various trigger points, you can see it happen, and know when it is about to turn worse because you already saw it last time. Then you change your response to something unexpected at that moment - you change the pattern - this will confuse her and starts to break the pattern. She may try the traditional response, expecting the traditional reaction, but when that doesn't happen, because you are not following that pattern anymore, it forces her brain to come up with something new, and thus also breaks her out of her side of the pattern.

Using this approach, you can dramatically improve the tone of the conversation between you, taking away from the negative emotions associated with the traditional responses. She probably won't even know you are doing it. You can use this as a tool to help you establish a newer and more productive pattern between the both of you, and breath life back into your relationship. You know, deliberately steer it back toward being fun again.

I have done this with people before, and it works. You can often get positive results immediately. However, as the old pattern stays in there a long time, it can take long term application of this method before the old pattern is completely erased. Basically, the negative pattern becomes hardwired in the brains of both of you. Your initial observations are about watching it as it unfolds, seeing how it works for both of you. Once you see it, you'll always see it when it is happening, so it becomes easy to work around it after that.

Over time, your newer and better pattern becomes the default pattern, and it replaces the old one.
